verdict.rationale: Devin's API is documented as enabling integration into applications and automated workflows, and sessions can be created programmatically on behalf of users, which could technically be wired into a CI/CD pipeline, but there is no explicit documentation or example of triggering Devin from CI/CD to fix a broken build or failing test.  missing for 10: explicit CI/CD (e.g. GitHub Actions/Jenkins) integration guide, documented failing-build/test trigger workflow, and evidence of it working in practice on build failures.
